EXTREME FIRE DANGER: Recreational fires are still allowed in Logan City limits if they are within a designated fire pit 25' feet away from
combustibles, if it is a green air day, and if the clearing index is above 500°. Avoid burning in windy conditions, always have someone
tending to the fire, and please use extreme caution.
